{{Quote|Formerly of Ord Mantell, possessed quite a few secrets the Diplomatic Service could make use of.|Vector Hyllus|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Yoganerr Thenoth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] prior to the [[Galactic War]]. Some time after he stepped over, the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] member [[Falner Oeth]] tried to obtain sensitive information from him by arranging a meeting with [[Vector Hyllus]], who could turn him into a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] [[Joiner]].<ref name="TOR" />
